mapper.select: SELECT l.agent_id FROM house_listing l JOIN property_unit u ON u.id = l.unit_id WHERE l.id = #{listingId} AND l.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND u.occupancy_status = 'VACANT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment(id, listing_id, tenant_id, agent_id, conversation_id, scheduled_at, contact_name, contact_mobile, note, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{listingId}, #{tenantId}, #{agentId}, #{conversationId}, #{scheduledAt}, #{contactName}, #{contactMobile}, #{note}, #{status}, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO chat_message(id, conversation_id, sender_id, message_type, content, appointment_id, created_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{appointmentId}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.listing_id AS listingId, l.title AS listingTitle, a.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.nickname AS tenantName, a.agent_id AS agentId, a.scheduled_at AS scheduledAt, a.contact_name AS contactName, a.contact_mobile AS contactMobile, a.note, a.status, a.reject_reason AS rejectReason, a.created_at AS createdAt FROM appointment a JOIN house_listing l ON l.id = a.listing_id JOIN sys_user t ON t.id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND (a.tenant_id = #{userId} OR a.agent_id = #{userId})
SELECT conversation_id FROM appointment WHERE id = #{id}
